Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:193723
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 40270 of 2023

Applicant :- Sehzaad
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Deepak Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed on behalf of the applicant in the Court is taken on record.
2.  Shri Pradeep Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent apprise the Court that on 11.09.2023, notice has been served to the informant of the case.
Despite service of notice, none appeared on behalf of the informant to oppose this application for bail.

3. Heard Shri Deepak Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant and Shri Pradeep Kumar, learned AGA for the State-respondent.
4.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.310 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Sheohara, District Bijnor, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that on the basis of false allegation of rape, applicant has been made accused in the present matter and after considering the entire facts of the case,

sentences.text: Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 01.12.2023 enlarged him on interim bail with a direction that in the meantime, he shall perform marriage with the victim and pursuant to the order passed by this Court, he has already performed marriage with the victim and a specific averment in this regard has been made in the supplementary affidavit dated 09.12.2024.

He further submits,
alongwith the supplementary affidavit Nikaahnama of applicant and victim has also been annexed.
6. He further submits that during trial, victim, who is now wife of the applicant, has also turned hostile.

7. He further submits that as earlier interim bail granted to the applicant could not be extended,
therefore, pursuant to the order passed by this Court, he has already surrendered before the court concerned and at present he is in custody and this fact is evident from the order of court concerned dated 07.12.2024, which has been annexed alongwith the supplementary affidavit.

8. It is next submitted, therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of case argued above,
applicant should be released on bail.

9. Per contra, learned AGA however opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant earlier was released on interim bail by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court and he had already performed marriage with the victim.

10. He further could not dispute the fact that during trial, victim, who is now wife of the applicant,
has turned hostile and pursuant to the previous order of this Court, applicant is in custody in the present matter.
11.
I have heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the record of the case.

12. However, as per allegation applicant committed rape upon the victim but it appears Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 01.12.2023 enlarged him on interim bail with a direction that he shall perform marriage with the victim and it appears, pursuant to the order passed by this Court,
applicant has already performed marriage with the victim and victim is residing in his home.
13. Further, record also suggests that victim of the case has already turned hostile during trial.

14. Further, from the record, it reflects that as interim bail granted to the applicant was not extended, therefore, this Court directed him to surrender before the trial court and it appears,
pursuant to the order passed by this Court, applicant has already been surrendered before the court concerned and at present he is in custody in the present matter.
15. Further, applicant is having no criminal history.

16. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

sentences.text: Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

18. Let the applicant- Sehzaad, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
19. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

20. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 10.12.2024 Zafar  Sehzaad vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164109762/
